1. (Currently Amended) A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product using a computing device; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product, wherein the generating step is performed by the computing device and transforms the stored user information into generated use information in a different form or format.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein receiving the unique identifier comprises reading the unique identifier from the package using an optical scanner or radio frequency identification reader operatively coupled to the computing device.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein receiving the unique identifier comprises receiving information stored in a radio frequency identification tag using a radio frequency identification reader operatively coupled to the computing device.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: searching a data store storing at least part of the at least use information using the unique identifier, wherein the searching is performed by the computing device.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 4, wherein searching the data store comprises transmitting the unique identifier to the data store over a network using the computing device.

6. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises: receiving at least part of the at least use information in a first form; and converting the at least part of the at least use information from the first form to a second form.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving the at least use information from the data store using the computing device.

8. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the product comprises a pharmaceutical product, and the at least use information comprises at least one of when a next dose of the product is to be taken, when a previous dose of a product was taken, and if a dose of the product is to be taken.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving user information regarding use of the product from a user via an input device operatively coupled to the computing device.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein receiving the user information regarding use of the product comprises receiving an input through a user device operatively coupled to the computing device.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein receiving the user information regarding use of the product comprises receiving the user information regarding use of the product stored in a radio frequency identification tag using a radio frequency identification reader operatively coupled to the computing device.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising receiving information from a secondary device operatively coupled to the computing device.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier is stored on at least one of the package, an identification card, an identification bracelet, a user information medium and a list of users, and is read by the computing device.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising providing past use information associated with the unique identifier to an authorized individual via the computing device.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising receiving a user profile via the computing device, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information based at least partially on the user profile using the computing device.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising generating an alert regarding use of the product based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product, wherein the alert is generated by the computing device.

17. (Previously presented) The method of claim 16, wherein the alert is an escalating alert and wherein the form of the alert escalates with each time no response to the alert is received.

18. (Previously presented) The method of claim 16, wherein the alert is customized by at least one of a user and an authorized individual.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying a user using the computing device.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 19, further comprising: comparing at least one of a first information type associated with the second unique identifier and the second unique identifier to at least one of the first information type associated with the first unique identifier or a user identifier associated with the first unique identifier using the computing device; and generating a wrong user alert if the at least one of the first information type associated with the second unique identifier and the second unique identifier does not match the at least one of the first information type associated with the first unique identifier or the user identifier associated with the first unique identifier, wherein the wrong user alert is generated by the computing device.

21. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 20, further comprising generating one or more escalating wrong user alerts when a previous wrong user alert is not acknowledged, wherein the escalating wrong user alerts are generated by the computing device.

22. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 19, wherein the user comprises a first user and the second unique identifier identifies a second user providing the product to the first user, the method further comprising: storing the second unique identifier in a data store in association with information regarding a particular instance of providing the product to the first user, wherein the storing is performed by the computing device.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 22, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to the role of the second user, wherein the generating is performed by the computing device.

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for the user receiving the product, wherein the generating is performed by the computing device.

25. (Currently Amended) A user device for providing information regarding a product, the user device comprising: a processor; a memory; and a communication interface, wherein the user device is configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing the product, generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier by executing instructions on the processor, and communicate with a data store via the communication interface, the data store storing the user information regarding past use of the product in association with the unique identifier and at least part of the at least use information.

26. (Currently Amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a computing device having a processor and memory, the computing device configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product, generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product associated with the unique identifier by executing instructions on the processor, and communicate with a network via a communication interface.

27. (Currently Amended) A system for providing information regarding a product, the system comprising: a computing device having a processor configured to receive a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and the processor further configured to generate at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product.

28. (Currently Amended) A computer readable storage medium on which is embedded one or more computer programs, said one or more computer programs implementing a method of providing information regarding a product, said one or more computer programs comprising a set of instructions executable on a processor for: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product; and generating at least use information based at least partially on stored user information regarding past use of the product, wherein the generating transforms the stored user information into generated use information in a different form or format.
